## Measurement methodology {#sec-methodology}

::: {.callout-note}

This section still needs to be written. 
The following outline is based on @wouters_ontwerp_2008-1.

:::

This building block is dedicated to the development of a first version of the measurement methodology.
This involves the following aspects:

- Selecting and locating sampling points in the field
  - Precise and clear method to avoid introducing bias or additional variability
  - Clear decision protocol for borderline and doubtful cases, or when practical circumstances prevent sampling

- Selecting and measuring measurement objects and variables
  - Measurement objects and variables, and analysis variables as some function of measurement variables
  - Standard measurement methodology based internationally accepted methods and protocols

- Pilot
  - Sampling and measurement methods are worked out as accurately as possible, based on knowledge or similar monitoring networks
  - First practice test and quality control 

Useful information can be found in @neeckx_occurrence_2024, @dhondt_muntjac_antwerp_2024, and @bollen_cameravallen_2025.
